notes: This contract pins the official C++ timestamped Update Attribute Values and Reflect Attribute Values declarations used by the bounded non-regional object-class Request Attribute Value Update response scenario. It also records the official Retract service because the provider-side response designator is checked at the post-delivery terminal boundary. The scenario deliberately keeps time-management, order-type, and object-class request/provide surfaces in their own contracts so the focused service lane can audit each cross-service dependency without treating this composite case as conformance evidence.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual MessageRetractionHandle updateAttributeValues( ObjectInstanceHandle const & objectInstance, AttributeHandleValueMap const & attributeValues, VariableLengthData const & userSuppliedTag, LogicalTime const & time) = 0
tests: cpp/tests/ieee1516_2025_federation_management_catch2.cpp::Embedded object-class Request Attribute Value Update supports a provider response

tests: cpp/tests/ieee1516_2025_federation_management_catch2.cpp::Embedded object-class Request Attribute Value Update supports a provider response
